invariants.rationale: By method contract, Option should not be null; it should be Option.empty() or Option.of(T).
The result is Option.empty() unless the metadata table is enabled or available and not isMetadataTable().
If this is a metadata table, always return Option.empty() (not present).
At least one controlling condition must be met for Option to possibly be present.
Result is present only if the metadata table exists and was enabled/available and not a metadata table; otherwise, not present.
